notes.title: Update for June 19th
notes.notes:
-Fixed passibility issues and typos. 
-A certain lategame battle in Castle Darkloft is now slightly easier.

notes.title: Update for April 22nd
notes.notes:
-Fixed a bug where Chisa using Drain Strike or Nebulous Siege while equipping an elemental weapon against a foe who absorbs that element would crash the game.

-One final achievement added to hint to the existence of an optional super-boss (you just have to meet the character to get the achievement)
